segments.text: The theory of relativity, proposed by Albert Einstein, revolutionized the field of physics. It suggests that the laws of physics are the same for all observers, regardless of their relative motion. This concept leads to the conclusion that time and space are interwoven into a single continuum known as spac

. One of the most famous implications of this theory is the concept of time dilation, where time appears to move slower for an object in motion compared to a stationary observer. As a result, if an astronaut travels at a significant fr

of the speed of light, they would age more slowly than their counterparts on Earth. This phenomenon has been proven experimentally, providing profound implications for our understanding of the universe and how we perceive c
. In summary, relativity challenges our intuitive grasp of time and space, presenting a framework that has been essential in modern physics.

academic.passage: Einstein's theory of relativity fundamentally changed our understanding of space and time. It asserts that the laws of physics are consistent for all observers, regardless of their relative speeds. Consequently, phenomena such as time dilation, where time differs based on motion, reveal complex interactions between time and the speed of light, leading to new explorations in physics.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Einstein's theory of relativity changed physics.
Time dilation occurs only for stationary observers.
questions.explain: 這段文字的核心主題是愛因斯坦的相對論對物理學的影響。

questions.q: What does time dilation refer to?
options: Differences in time measurement based on speed.
An effect of gravity on time.
questions.explain: 時間膨脹是指根據速度的不同，時間測量的差異。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the implications of relativity?
options: It only applies to Earth-based observations.
It has no impact on modern physics.
It leads to new understandings of the universe.
It is widely accepted by all scientists.
questions.explain: 相對論對宇宙的理解產生了深遠的影響，這是文中所提到的。

questions.q: What does the term 'spacetime' refer to in the context of the passage?
options: A combination of space and time.
questions.explain: 在這段文字中，'時空'指的是空間和時間的結合。

daily.passage: Attention students! The university will hold a career fair on March 15th from 10 AM to 4 PM in the Student Center. This is a great opportunity to meet potential employers and learn about various job openings.

questions.q: What is the date of the career fair?
questions.explain: 通知中提到的職業博覽會日期是三月十五日。

questions.q: Where will the career fair take place?
questions.explain: 職業博覽會將在學生中心舉行。
